error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

apiError.network_error: Connection lost. Nothing was sent. Try again.
apiError.cart_changed: Some items changed or sold out. Check the order and try again.
apiError.version_conflict: Someone else just updated this order.
apiError.invalid_transition: This order cannot be moved that way.
apiError.insufficient_cash: The amount given is less than the total.
apiError.refund_required: This order was paid. Choose how the money goes back.
apiError.not_refundable: There is nothing left to refund on this order.
apiError.weak_password: Password must be at least 10 characters and not a common one.
apiError.email_required: Owner accounts need an email address.
apiError.image_too_large: Images must be 5 MB or smaller.
apiError.invalid_image: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
apiError.forbidden: You do not have access to do that.
apiError.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
apiError.account_locked: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
apiError.device_not_registered: This device is not registered as the shop tablet.
apiError.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

shop.closedBody: Have a look at the menu. Ordering opens when we do.
shop.pausedBody: We're very busy. Please order at the counter or try again shortly.

login.title: Sign in

login.withPassword: Sign in with a password instead

pin.title: Unlock
pin.noStaff: No staff have a PIN yet. The owner sets PINs on the Staff page.
pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in 15 minutes.

staff.onlineOrdersHint: Pause during a rush. Orders already paid still come through.

board.changedElsewhere: Order {{number}} was updated on another screen.

cancel.title: Cancel order {{number}}

cancel.refundLater: The owner refunds it through the online payment
cancel.refundGatewayDone: Already refunded in the payment gateway

payment.title: Payment
payment.confirmReceived: Confirm the payment went through on the terminal or QR before you tap.

search.placeholder: Order number, order ID, phone or name
search.hint: Staff can search the last 7 days.

soldOut.hint: Switch off anything that has run out. Everything comes back on automatically after closing.
soldOut.blockedByOption: Unavailable: a required option has run out

menu.title: Menu
menu.optionGroupsHint: Shown in the order you pick them.
menu.categoriesHint: A category with no visible items is hidden from customers automatically.
menu.addCategoryFirst: Add a category first, on the Categories tab.
menu.photoAfterSave: Save the item first, then add a photo.

groups.hint: One group, like Sauces, can be used on many items. Marking an option sold out removes it everywhere.

staff.title: Staff
staff.name: Full name
staff.pinHint: 4 to 6 digits, for the shop tablet.
staff.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots or dashes.
staff.resetSignsOut: They will be signed out everywhere.
staff.deactivateBody: They are signed out immediately and cannot sign in. Their orders and history are kept.

settings.onlineOrdersHint: Pause new online orders at any time. Staff can do this from the board too.
settings.prepHint: Shown to customers. Cards on the board turn amber after this.
settings.hoursHint: A closing time earlier than the opening time means the shop closes after midnight. The same opening and closing time means open 24 hours.
settings.tabletHint: Register the shared counter tablet once. Staff then unlock it with their PIN instead of a password.
settings.register: Register this device as the shop tablet
settings.tabletRegistered: This device is the shop tablet.
settings.totpOffBody: Your account controls the menu, money and staff. Protect it with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator.
settings.totpStep1: 1. In your authenticator app, add an account and enter this key:

customer.someUnavailable: Some items are no longer available. Remove them to continue.
customer.cartChanged: Something in your order changed. Check the items and total, then pay again.
customer.phoneInvalid: Enter a Malaysian phone number, for example 012-345 6789.
customer.tooManyUnpaid: You have unpaid orders. Pay for or cancel those first.
customer.phoneHint: Optional. Only used if the shop needs to reach you about this order.
customer.pickupOnly: Pickup at the counter. Pay now online.
customer.privacy: If you give a phone number, it is used only for this order, as described in the shop's privacy notice.

tracking.readyBody: Come to the counter and show this number.
tracking.notFound: We couldn't find that order. Check the link.
tracking.refundComing: You paid for this order. The shop will refund you.
tracking.keepLink: Keep this page. It updates by itself.
tracking.justPaid: Just paid? This page updates in a few seconds.
tracking.expiresIn: Pay within {{time}} or the order is cancelled.
